evidence_source: Consensus academic-paper search and fetched paper records
claim_boundary: validates pipeline design choices and required risk controls, not local output correctness or operational aviation safety
overall_verdict: The current pipeline design is literature-supported as an ontology-constrained, retrospective aviation data integration and evidence-traceable QA experiment. The design must keep LLM-derived advisory/event triples behind evidence, schema, temporal, and human-review gates, and must not claim GraphRAG universally improves Recall@k.

stage_validations.required_control: Keep raw payload hashes, retrieval commands, source effective dates, parser versions, and local raw paths for every source record.
Treat ATMONTO as primary TBox/schema baseline, not ABox ground truth.
Use AIRM-O as audit and gap-analysis source only; do not replace ATMONTO unless the experiment is redesigned.
Use deterministic translators for structured official fields; avoid LLM extraction as the primary parser for stable fields.
Keep hybrid Docling plus PyMuPDF and use reference documents for chunks, terminology, and evidence rather than live facts.
Constrain output classes and properties, require exact evidence, run domain/range validation, and keep event/causal triples bronze until reviewed.
Add accepted/rejected/bronze statuses and state that SHACL/domain-range validation is structural conformance, not semantic truth.
Keep claims to retrospective integration and query/search support; separate source coverage gaps from ontology gaps.
Keep source-only and vector-only baselines and claim GraphRAG value only when metrics support it.
Preserve separate retrieval, graph, answer, citation, abstention, and ontology/KG metrics; label CQs by required source family.
Use deterministic structured fields as silver, reviewed samples as gold, and LLM event/causal triples as bronze until reviewed.
Keep wording to retrospective, evidence-traceable aviation QA; avoid live operational or certification language.

recommended_design_strengthening: Add pipeline-level quality labels for deterministic silver, LLM bronze, manual gold, and rejection reasons.
Add SHACL or equivalent domain/range validation before KG acceptance.
Keep deterministic translator upper bounds for structured records.
Require exact evidence containment for all LLM-produced triples.
Review ATCSCC advisory time windows and impacting-condition fields before gold use.
Evaluate competency questions by required source family and unsupported/no-answer status.
Keep GraphRAG metrics layered and do not collapse them into one score.
Use AIRM-O as alignment audit only.

pass_fail_gates.name: source_snapshot_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Every source family has a manifest with URL, command, retrieved time, source effective date, raw hash, parser version, and known limitations.

pass_fail_gates.name: ontology_profile_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: NASA ATMONTO profile parses successfully and exposes selected classes/properties/domains/ranges used by the experiment.

pass_fail_gates.name: deterministic_translator_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Structured sources produce normalized JSONL with record counts, source IDs, and stable entity keys.

pass_fail_gates.name: llm_evidence_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Every LLM candidate triple has exact source evidence and source record provenance.

pass_fail_gates.name: schema_validation_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Accepted triples have allowed classes/properties and pass domain/range or SHACL-equivalent checks.

pass_fail_gates.name: review_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: LLM-derived event, causal, and ambiguous temporal triples remain bronze until manual review.

pass_fail_gates.name: retrieval_qa_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Source-only, vector-only, and KG-enabled variants are compared on the same CQs with separate retrieval, graph, answer, citation, and abstention metrics.

pass_fail_gates.name: claim_gate
pass_fail_gates.pass_condition: Final claims are mapped to evidence artifacts and negative results remain visible.
